RXV2-0.9.89-big-pad: Sim controls is now one tall column of big, easy-to-hit targets filling the screen, in order Select · Up · Down · Cancel · Reset — Reset largest at the bottom, like the spacebar. Same colours and Up/Down auto-repeat. Page-only change; no re-calibration.
RXV2-0.9.88-sim-pad: Sim controls redesigned as a proper pad: big red Reset, green Select, amber Cancel, and a stacked ▲/▼ Up/Down rocker. Up and Down now AUTO-REPEAT — hold the on-screen button (or a TX switch on ch12/ch13) to scroll a menu continuously. Joystick descriptor unchanged (8 buttons), so no re-calibration.
RXV2-0.9.87-ui-buttons: Sim controls page now shows exactly RealFlight's 5 User Interface functions — Reset, Select, Cancel, Up, Down (ch9→Reset … ch13→Down) — instead of generic labels. The joystick is unchanged (still 8 HID buttons under the hood), so no re-calibration is needed.
RXV2-0.9.86-sim-buttons: Sim mode gains 8 function buttons on the USB joystick — fire them from the new 'Sim controls' phone page OR from your transmitter's switches on channels 9-16 (ch9→button1 … ch16→button8). Bind each to a sim function (reset, pause, view…) in your sim's controller setup, and control the sim with no keyboard. Adding buttons changes the joystick, so it needs one re-calibration in the sim.
RXV2-0.9.85-fresh-ui: Web pages are now sent no-store, so a freshly-updated UI appears immediately instead of the browser (iOS Safari especially) showing a stale cached copy — no hard-refresh needed.
RXV2-0.9.84-fs-auto: The receiver now derives its web-filesystem URL from the firmware URL when the page doesn't supply it, so it pulls its own web files on the next update even from a stale page — updating twice fully self-heals an out-of-date UI, no computer needed. Backups still preserved.
RXV2-0.9.83-fs-ota: OTA install now also flashes the matching web/data filesystem (and preserves your Rotorflight backups), so the web UI travels with the firmware on every update — no separate uploadfs needed. First release that ships a littlefs.bin.
RXV2-0.9.82-tx-happy: Firmware-update check no longer stalls the radio while the TX link is live (it was starving radioPoll and dropping the transmitter); shorter idle timeouts.
RXV2-0.9.81-wifi-heal: WiFi self-heals from AP-only — retries the home network every 20 s when it has saved credentials, instead of staying stranded. Plus a big SIMULATOR-MODE-ON home banner.
RXV2-0.9.80-sim-safe: Drive-simulator-over-USB now disables the flight-controller output (D6 stays silent) so a real model can't be flown from sim mode; default channel map shown as a tidy 1:1.
RXV2-0.9.79-usb-sim-remap: Adds the Remap-channels page for simulator mode (feed any of the 8 sim outputs from any received channel, with live bars).
RXV2-0.9.78-usb-sim: First release with Drive-simulator-over-USB: the receiver can present as a USB HID joystick for a PC flight sim, driven by the channels it receives — no separate dongle.
